sync.sheet: Sync Sync needs the 12 words on this device. Join again with your recovery words. Your data stays stored on this device. Sync is optional and end-to-end encrypted: your data is encrypted on your device before it syncs. There's no account. 12 recovery words are the only key, and they can't be recovered if you lose them. Join with 12 words Start sync Your 12 recovery words Write these down. Anyone with them can read your data; if you lose every device and the words, the synced copy can't be recovered. ai.sheet: Import with AI Peek Budget has no connection to any AI service. The app never sends anything: what you upload is between you and the provider you choose. Privacy claims belong to each provider and can change. Check them yourself before you upload anything. Remove account numbers, card numbers and names first. The app only needs the merchant, amount and date. AI can misread documents, so check every row before you import. Nothing is imported until you confirm. Choosing a tool Look for one that says it keeps no chat logs, doesn't train on your data, and has a temporary or incognito chat mode. Export a backup first (10 items) Optional. Saves your 10 items as a file you can import again. Read the points above first… Drag to the end, or use the arrow keys. It unlocks after a moment. Or tick: I've read this Cancel Continue 1. Copy the prompt It describes the format the app needs and asks the AI to check unclear dates with you instead of guessing. Copy prompt Couldn't copy. Select the prompt below and copy it.
